about.opening: Class of 2026 (Special Selection) · Full-stack Developer · CTF Novice
about.statement: “Programming isn’t just a stack of logic; it’s an order waiting to be defined.”
items: From Neihu High School (36th IT Class) to an incoming NCHU Applied Mathematics student, I am navigating the intersection where mathematics meets code.
As the IT Head of SCAICT, I thrive on leading teams to build “generational” projects rather than just coding in isolation.
Dedicated to developing projects that streamline the student academic journey, using code to bring meaningful change to the educational environment.
A Full-Stack developer and CTF novice, constantly pushing my limits through the thrill of building systems and hunting for vulnerabilities.

quote.text: 世界は、自分の思っているより、ずっとずっとカラフルなんだ。
